editorial:
Imagine arriving in a dusty Texas town where everyone seems to be hiding a secret. You follow a Texas Ranger who comes to Helena to figure out why so many people are dying in strange ways. The whole place feels tense, and you can tell from the start that something is very wrong. It is not your typical cowboy movie with big shootouts every five minutes. Instead, it feels more like a mystery where you are trying to piece together the truth alongside the main character while dealing with locals who do not want to help.

What really works here is the acting and the way the story slowly reveals its secrets. The pacing is a bit slow at first, but the payoff is worth it. If you like movies that make you think and keep you guessing, you will love this one. To get the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the grit and detail of the desert. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for the high picture quality.
endingExplained: You eventually find out that the town is run by a cult that believes in a dark kind of purity. The twist is that the deaths were not accidents but were part of a twisted plan to cleanse the town. In the final scenes, the Ranger has to fight his way out of a trap and face the people leading the cult. He manages to survive and expose the truth, bringing an end to the madness in Helena.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Westerns with a twist and mystery plots.
